create_DenoisingConfig: create a DenoisingConfig with model name, sample rate, and optional audio format settings
create_Demucs: create a Demucs instance initialized with a DenoisingConfig for audio denoising
test_Demucs_init: test the Demucs class initialization sets denoise_config model and sample_rate correctly
test_Demucs_denoise: test the Demucs denoise method processes audio and returns a MemoryBlock result
run_Demucs_cleanup: run the Demucs cleanup_temp_files method to remove temporary files created during denoising
